nodes.name: A deal is marked Won
nodes.notes: PRODUCTION: CRM fires this on stage → Closed Won (GoHighLevel/HubSpot workflow webhook). One event, the whole company reacts.

nodes.name: Read the deal details
nodes.notes: Maps the raw CRM payload to a canonical deal object the downstream departments consume.

parameters.jsCode:
const d=$input.first().json;
return [{ json:{ department:"Sales", system:"GoHighLevel", action:"Opportunity → Closed Won", deal:d.dealId, status:"ok" }}];

nodes.name: Sales: mark it Won
nodes.notes: PRODUCTION: PATCH GoHighLevel /opportunities/{id} status=won (or HubSpot deals API).

parameters.jsCode:
const d=$input.first().json;
return [{ json:{ department:"Finance", system:"Stripe", action:"Customer + first invoice created", amount:"$"+d.acv, invoice:"in_demo_8842", status:"ok" }}];

const d=$input.first().json;
return [{ json:{ department:"Ops", system:"Notion", action:"Onboarding checklist (8 tasks) created", owner:d.owner, status:"ok" }}];

nodes.name: Ops: build the onboarding checklist
nodes.notes: PRODUCTION: Notion pages.create in the Onboarding DB — 1 checklist, 8 tasks, owner assigned.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json:{ department:"Support", system:"Intercom", action:"Account provisioned + welcome sent", status:"ok" }}];

nodes.name: Support: set up their account
nodes.notes: PRODUCTION: Intercom contacts.create + companies.attach + welcome macro.

parameters.jsCode:
const d=$input.first().json;
return [{ json:{ department:"Marketing", system:"Klaviyo", action:"Enrolled in onboarding flow", profile:d.email, status:"ok" }}];

nodes.name: Marketing: start the welcome emails
nodes.notes: PRODUCTION: Klaviyo profiles.subscribe → triggers the onboarding email flow.

parameters.jsCode:
const d=$input.first().json;
return [{ json:{ department:"Exec", system:"Slack", action:"#revenue: New Build deal +$"+d.acv+" ("+d.company+")", status:"ok" }}];

nodes.name: Leadership: post the good news
nodes.notes: PRODUCTION: Slack chat.postMessage to #revenue with the deal summary.

nodes.name: Confirm it all ran
nodes.notes: Confirms every department acted. In production this is the audit record of the cascade.

nodes.name: Done — team notified
nodes.notes: Terminal: leadership gets one clean summary instead of six tools' worth of noise.
